documents.refund: Refunds for purchases paid by card can take five business days to appear on the original payment method.
documents.cancellation: Cancel a monthly subscription in Billing settings. You keep access to your plan through the end of the paid period.
documents.mfa: To add a second authentication factor, open Account Security and enroll an authenticator app. Store the recovery codes offline.
documents.password: Reset a forgotten password from the sign-in screen. The email reset link expires after twenty minutes.
documents.export: Download a copy of your activity history as a CSV file from the Reports page. Choose the start date and end date.
documents.rename: Edit the team display name from Workspace Settings. Only a workspace administrator can save the change.
documents.shipping: Track a shipment from the Orders page with its carrier tracking number. Delivery can be delayed by weather.
documents.storage: To free available storage, open the Projects page and delete exported archives you no longer need. The plan limit is ten gigabytes.
